method_specification.descriptor_stated_b.reason: Method sections precede Results, but they do not fully specify the architecture and training procedure. RBF construction, learned cutoff values, optimizer, learning rate, training duration, and clipping threshold require code inspection. method_specification.architecture_fully_.reason: The paper supplies radial/angular pooling equations, two hidden layers, width 32, tanh, K′=16, and a 100-neighbor cap. method_specification.hyperparameters_lis.reason: The paper's hyperparameter documentation is insufficient to reproduce the protocol. Adam, learning rate 0.001, CV/full-data epoch counts, clipping norm 10, initialization seeds, RBF settings, and concrete per-material learned cutoffs are not adequately listed; run records do not supply a complete executed configuration.

method_specification.invariance_claims_s.reason: Distance/angle pooling provides an intended symmetry mechanism, but invariance of the complete implemented descriptor is not established. Its periodic-image vector construction is not rotation-covariant, and the measured order-one energy drifts contradict the claimed machine-precision behavior of the complete pipeline.

method_specification.energy_form_preserv.reason: The implementation subtracts the isolated-atom descriptor, includes linear features and every upper-triangular quadratic product, uses no free constant, and performs a final least-squares head fit. Forces differentiate that same energy. The product-coefficient convention is equivalent to a symmetric quadratic form.

method_specification.motivation_grounded.reason: The motivation references symmetry functions, SNAP, ACE, and post-2018 learned potentials, and identifies the fixed quadratic least-squares head as the distinction. Comparisons remain brief and do not deeply position LRA's representational or optimization choices.

invariance_compliance.drift_engagement_q.reason: The paper distinguishes test types and attributes large drift to wrapping and small force denominators.
